# f5xc_forward_proxy_policy (Data Source)

Forward Proxy Policy Forward Proxy policy defines access control rules for connections going via forward Proxy. It is view type of config object that uses service policy mechanism to achieve Required functionality. View will create following child objects. * Service Policy * Service Policy Rule
